name: RRSOS PCC Resupply
description: Everything about storage crates and what is in them. Label a crate (Container1-3) with an item's name and its empty slots are filled once, at the rename (whole-name matches only; what is in the crate stays). A recycle-arrows icon on a crate's window refills that crate with the item its label or category names. A Supply Manager screen in the build menu (Iron, Silicon, Aluminium): Set Drone Demand makes every crate with an item ask the drones for it, Set Drone Supply makes producers (extractors, collectors, hives, ecosystem) offer what they make, Resupply fills the crates, Purge Extractors (once the T2 ore extractor is unlocked) leaves each extractor on a vein with only that vein's ore, and Auto Top-Up (off by default) keeps crates above a fill level. Chat commands: /resupply fills every crate with its item, /resupply add <item id> <name> gives an item another name for labels.

commands.name: /resupply
commands.help: fill every crate with its item

commands.name: /resupply add
commands.help: give an item another name for crate labels
